# G3b PRISMA-style flow (generated by `scripts/p4_g3b_screening.py` from `prisma_counts.json`; do not edit by hand)

## Identification
Locked query (docs/G3B_AUDIT_PROTOCOL.md §1), publication years 2022–2026, searches run 2026-10-29. Raw hits: **678** — OpenAlex 320, SemanticScholar 231, GoogleScholar 100, PubMed 14, arXiv 13 (`search_raw.csv`, `search_log.json`).
* OpenAlex: boolean title/abstract search plus the citation checks (works citing Oliveira 2022 and the Reyna Challenge papers, murmur filter).
* **Semantic Scholar limitation:** the queries 'CirCor murmur', 'PhysioNet 2022 murmur' returned HTTP 429 (rate limit) in the main run and again in one retry (≥ 5 s between calls, max 3 tries; `scripts/p4_g3b_s2_retry.py`). The authors accepted the gap; these terms are covered by OpenAlex and the citation checks.
* **Google Scholar method:** manual Google Scholar export as 14 screenshots (no HTML, no Publish or Perish); query as locked; custom range 2022-2026; relevance order; 20 results/page; 7 pages captured (about 474 hits); 2026-10-29. ranks 1-100 transcribed from the screenshots by Claude (cloud workspace) into scholar_manual.csv; checked against the PNGs, 0 errors (scholar_transcription_check.md). Screened: ranks 1-100 (locked protocol: first 100); ranks 101-140 kept in scholar_manual_extra_rank101-140.csv, NOT screened. DOIs/URLs are not visible in screenshots, so each record was resolved by title match via OpenAlex, Crossref fallback (scripts/p4_g3b_screen_prep.py): 88 resolved by title match, 12 unresolved (kept with the Scholar metadata). OpenAlex free daily budget was exhausted on 2026-10-29 (HTTP 429, retry-after ~23 h) after the main searches; records it could not answer were resolved via Crossref only.
* **Other sources:** 2 records not retrieved by the locked searches (`other_sources.csv`): Nogueira et al. 2026 (pilot list; its abstract names CirCor but not "murmur", so the locked query cannot find it) and Ladislaus et al. 2026 (related-work check requested by the authors). Reported separately below.

## Deduplication
By DOI, then normalised title; journal/proceedings version kept and the preprint linked (`dedup.csv`). 678 hits − 399 duplicate hits = **279 unique records**.

## Screening (title/abstract, Claude Code; every decision and reason in `screening_decisions.csv` / `screening.csv`)
Excluded: **141** — not about heart sounds 90; no CirCor murmur performance number 37; duplicate 9; review/survey 5. ("Duplicate" here = the same study reported twice under different titles, e.g. a CinC paper and its journal extension; the journal version is kept.)

## Full-text eligibility
Assessed: **138**. Excluded at full text: 3 — Outcome-only 2; duplicate 1. **Pending: 39** — full text not retrievable by script (paywalled, or the publisher blocks automated download); eligibility could not be confirmed from the abstract. They stay in `screening.csv` with status `pending` and must be checked by the team with library access; none is silently dropped.

## Included
From the database searches: **96**; from other sources: **2**; **total 98** (`included.csv`), plus up to 39 pending. All 11 pilot papers of docs/P3_G3_AUDIT.md are present: Nogueira 2026 (O001: include), Nie 2024 (R162: include), Patwa 2025 (R215: include), Niizumi 2024 (R140: include), Zhang ICASSP 2024 (R160: include), McDonald 2024 (R123: include), Walker 2022 (R075: include), Elola 2023 (R067: include), Vimalajeewa 2025 (R221: include), Dehghan Manshadi & Mihandoost 2024 (R164: include), Ameen 2026 (R244: include).

Eligibility of most included records was confirmed from the abstract (a CirCor/PhysioNet 2022 murmur result is stated); the rest from the full text (see `ft_note`). Coding uses the full text in every case (`evidence_pack.md`).
